# War Scroll Column 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** complete

---

**5:1** The horsemen-of [...] upon the right and upon the left of the battle-line. They-shall-place on both-sides of the battle-line horsemen. Their horsemen shall-be six-thousand —

**5:2** five-hundred to-each tribe. And the horsemen who go-forth with-the-infantry to-battle: their riders shall-be men-of valor. And they-shall-be between thirty and forty-five years-of-age.

**5:3** And the horsemen upon the mounts — their age shall-be between forty and fifty years-of age. And they and their mounts shall-wear breastplates-of armor, and helmets and greaves,

**5:4** and they-shall-hold in their hands circular-shields, and a spear-of eight cubits-of length in their hand, and a bow and arrows and a dagger-of war.

**5:5** And all-of-them shall-be prepared in-unity-of purpose to-slay those-who-are-slain-of God. And the horsemen-of the men-of battle shall-be beside the bulls-of

**5:6** the burnt-offering: twelve. And the chiefs-of [...] shall-be beside the bulls continuously. And the rule-of the horsemen: they-shall-select-for-themselves from-all the tribes-of Israel

**5:7** men-of valor for-the-cavalry, and they-shall-prepare-for-them horses swift-of foot and tender-of mouth and long-of wind and full-of days,

**5:8** and practiced runners, and men who-know-how to-ride upon-them. Their age: from thirty to forty-five years-of age. And the horsemen-of the line shall-be between

**5:9** forty and fifty years-of age. And they [...] the saddle-cloths. And their horses shall-be covered with breastplates-of

**5:10** mail, and helmets and greaves upon-their-legs. And they-shall-hold shields [...] and a lance-of eight cubits. And the bo[w]

**5:11** and arrows and the dagger-of war shall-be girded upon-their-loins. And all-these shall ride upon the mares [...] when the lot falls-to-them. And no

**5:12** lame-one or blind-one or crippled-one, and no man in whom there-is a permanent-blemish upon his flesh, or a man smitten with an uncleanness-of his flesh —

**5:13** all-these shall not go-forth with-them to-war. All-of-them shall-be men-of war, volunteers, perfect-of spirit and flesh. And the holy

**5:14** angels shall-be with their armies. And no youth shall-be among-them on the day-of battle, for the holy angels-are with-them

**5:15** together. And a space shall-be between all their camps and the place-of the hand [latrine], about two-thousand cubits, and no

**5:16** unseemly nakedness-of any-thing shall-be-seen in the surroundings of all their camps. And the officers-of the camps shall-be between

**5:17** forty and fifty years-of age, and those who arrange the camps and their equipment and all their provisions [...] shall-be men-of understanding.

---

*EMET notes: Column 5 specifies cavalry regulations: age requirements, equipment (breastplates, helmets, greaves, shields, spears of 8 cubits, bows, arrows, daggers), and horse selection criteria ("swift-of foot, tender-of mouth, long-of wind, full-of days"). The purity laws of 5:12-15 echo Deuteronomy 23:10-15. "Place-of the hand" (5:15) is the standard Hebrew euphemism for latrine. Hyphenated compounds preserve the detailed Hebrew construct chains describing military equipment.*
